answer: Issue identities only from a bounded locality graph: each new key must be seeded by a member within 4 hops of an anchored root, and every 12 epochs the graph is re-sampled. Sybils cluster in tight subgraphs and fail the hop test unless they bridge into real neighbourhoods, which leaks real social cost. Verification is a signed path proof of at most 4 edges per epoch. Honest agents join through a familiar comet, sponsors root like a willow, and a manufactured opal of local edges gets pruned to nothing at re-sampling.
